agency.name: Commonwealth Healthcare Corporation — Community Guidance Center

narrNote: No Northern Mariana Islands affiliate appears on NARR's official affiliate list (narronline.org/affiliates, fetched and read in-run 2026-10-22). Left null — never inferred.
notes: The Community Guidance Center (CGC) of the Commonwealth Healthcare Corporation (CHCC) is the CNMI's designated territorial behavioral health agency (per an HRSA program narrative) and operates the CNMI 988 program. CHCC's official site, chcc.gov.mp, rendered in-run via browser (command-line fetches from this machine failed, but the site loads and its content matches CHCC); the phone shown, (670) 234-8950, is CHCC's main line published in the site's FAQ. stateCrisis null: 988 is supported in the CNMI and CGC runs the local program per federal program documents, but no official CNMI crisis page URL could be fetched and verified in-run, so the field was left null rather than guessed. two11 null: no 211 service was identified for the CNMI. peerOrgs empty: the SAAR program's HOPE Recovery Center is the CNMI's residential recovery program but is a government program under the Office of the Governor (published on governor.gov.mp), not a peer organization, and no peer-led organization with a verifiable official website was found in-run. medicaidSud URL is the Commonwealth Medicaid Agency site (fetched 200). countyDirectory null: single-territory jurisdiction served directly by CHCC.
